story.originalTitle: FP2 complete. On to tomorrow. Following the issues during FP1, the team identified the problem on the car and worked to get it on track in FP2. Unfort...
story.summaryEn:
FP2 complete. On to tomorrow. 
Following the issues during FP1, the team identified the problem on the car and worked to get it on track in FP2.
Unfortunately, the amount of work required means Nico won’t be able to take part in the session.
detailZh:
FP2完成。转向明天。
在FP1期间出现的问题后，车队在FP2中确定了车辆的问题，并努力使其在FP2中回到赛道。
遗憾的是，所需的工作量意味着尼科无法参加本节练习。
detailEn:
FP2 complete. On to tomorrow. 
Following the issues during FP1, the team identified the problem on the car and worked to get it on track in FP2.
Unfortunately, the amount of work required means Nico won’t be able to take part in the session.
